floorPlans.note: Totals include balconies or terraces; they are not plot areas. Repeated types have separate unit-specific sheets. Building A sheet5 prints a balcony component that leaves a 1.00sqft discrepancy against its printed total; that total is retained for confirmation. Other 0.01sqft differences reflect rounded components. The earlier research caveat concerns an overprinted page in the merged pack. Building B now uses a separate, clean Emaar-branded broker-hosted booklet, including Type B1 at775.86sqft on its physical page6. The selected sheet controls its PDF download and source page. Confirm the current signed unit plan with Emaar.
